question: Choose the incorrectly spelt word.
solution:
The answer is **'Option 2'** i.e. **'Sleam'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **incorrectly spelled **word in the given options is **"Sleam".**
 
• The** correct spelling** **might depend** on the intended meaning of the word, as** there isn't a directly corresponding correctly spelled word** in English.

Therefore, the **incorrectly spelt word** is: **'Sleam'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Let's now examine the other words:
 
 
• **"Cream"** - This is correctly spelled. Cream refers to the thick white or pale yellow fatty liquid which rises to the top when milk is left to stand and which can be eaten as an accompaniment to desserts or used as a cooking ingredient. (क्रीम)
 
• **"Beam"** - This is correctly spelled. A beam is a long, sturdy piece of squared timber or metal used to support the roof or floor of a building, or, in another sense, it can refer to a ray or shaft of light. (बीम)
 
• **"Steam" **- This is correctly spelled. Steam is the vapor into which water is converted when heated, forming a white mist of minute water droplets in the air.(भाप)
